AUDIENCE & TESTABILITY:
API audience: USER-FACING.
Harness testability: TESTABLE.
Scoring recommendation: include in main user-facing denominator.

ROOT CAUSE:
The documentation incorrectly claims that requesting an unsupported format via `Thumbnails.Builder.outputFormat(String)` will throw an `UnsupportedFormatException` during the terminal sink operation. In reality, `outputFormat(String)` eagerly validates the format against registered ImageIO writers and throws an `IllegalArgumentException` immediately. The snippet failed because it attempted to trigger the exception organically using this flawed pipeline advice instead of directly exercising the exception's constructors and methods.

CORRECT USAGE:
```java
net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.UnsupportedFormatException ex1 = 
    new net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.UnsupportedFormatException("webp");

net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.UnsupportedFormatException ex2 = 
    new net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.UnsupportedFormatException(
        net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.UnsupportedFormatException.UNKNOWN, 
        "No suitable ImageWriter found"
    );

assert "webp".equals(ex1.getFormatName());
assert net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.UnsupportedFormatException.UNKNOWN.equals(ex2.getFormatName());
assert "No suitable ImageWriter found".equals(ex2.getMessage());
```

REQUIRED TYPES & IMPORTS:
net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.UnsupportedFormatException

DOC MUST SAY:
- `Thumbnails.Builder.outputFormat(String)` eagerly throws `IllegalArgumentException` if the format is unsupported, it does NOT throw `UnsupportedFormatException`.
- To test or use the `UnsupportedFormatException` API itself, instantiate it directly using its public constructors `(String formatName)` or `(String formatName, String message)`.
- The exception provides a `getFormatName()` method to retrieve the unsupported format name.
- The class provides a `public static final String UNKNOWN` constant to represent unidentified formats.
